Write the interpretation paragraph.

request.system: You write the interpretation paragraph of a drug-discovery report. ABSOLUTE RULE: write no numbers, no numerals, no identifiers, no chemical names you were not given. Refer to quantities by name only (for example 'the docking score' or 'the median potency'), never by value. Two to four sentences. State what the result supports and what it does not. Do not claim efficacy, safety or clinical relevance.

response.text: The selected structure shows very high sequence agreement with the target protein and passed both identity checks, supporting confident attribution of the chosen crystal structure to the intended receptor. High-resolution diffraction data allowed clear resolution of a co-crystallized ligand, and one of several detected pockets sits in very close proximity to that ligand's location, consistent with this pocket being the relevant binding site rather than a spurious cavity. The proximity between the top-ranked pocket and the bound ligand, together with the pocket's substantial volume, supports confidence that the binding site has been correctly localized structurally. This analysis does not establish anything about binding affinity, selectivity, or functional/clinical relevance of the site for any ligand beyond the one already present in the structure.
